A credit may be requested only when an SLA breach is evidenced in the ticket history. body_markdown:
# Duplicate shipment events from a carrier feed

If the carrier gateway is below 3.0.2 a feed re-sync clears duplicates. A re-sync is a production action and requires on-call SRE approval. Check last re-sync time first; never re-sync one integration more than once in 48 hours. After approval re-sync that single integration only and confirm event counts after 45 minutes.
title: Duplicate shipment events from a carrier feed

body_markdown:
# Carrier feed has stopped delivering events

No events for more than 20 minutes: first check platform incidents for the carrier gateway. If an incident is open, escalate to engineering and link it; do not re-sync. Otherwise verify the carrier credential, then request a re-sync (SRE approval).
title: Carrier feed has stopped delivering events
